description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions in the OpenClaw project, including functions related to date age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry point discovery, log file selection, and handling missing configurations.

classes.name: UtilitiesTests
classes.description: A test suite class containing multiple test functions for utility functions.

methods.name: age strings cover common windows
methods.description: Tests the age formatting for different time intervals.

methods.name: parse SSH target supports user port and defaults
methods.description: Tests parsing SSH target strings with user, host, and port.

methods.name: sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix
methods.description: Tests the connection settings parsing when remote target includes an SSH prefix.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin
methods.description: Checks that the gateway entry point function prefers the 'dist' directory over 'bin'.

methods.name: log locator picks newest log file
methods.description: Verifies that the log locator picks the most recently modified log file.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint nil when missing
methods.description: Tests that the gateway entry point returns nil when the directory does not exist.
